{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment=0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows strong downward momentum (e.g., 3+ consecutive drops).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true values if sentiment is positive (sentiment>0.00) — model should follow recent price action more closely.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is >15% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 10-20%.",
    "Avoid overshoot after sharp spikes: if true price drops sharply after a forecast peak, reduce next forecast by 15-25%.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, apply a 3-5% downward bias if historical error shows consistent underestimation of true values.",
    "If sentiment history includes a single positive signal (sentiment=0.50), slightly increase forecast to reflect potential bullish momentum, but cap at 10% above prior 15-day average."
  ]
}
